gui.movinglightblock.empty: Place a crafting table, furnace or chest
message.movinglightblock.not_owner: This light belongs to another player
movinglightblock.configuration.enabled.t: Turn off to disable the following light block entirely.
movinglightblock.configuration.animation: Tumble the cube while it follows; off keeps it upright.
movinglightblock.configuration.passThrou: On: ignore block collisions. Off: collide with blocks but never block or push players.
movinglightblock.configuration.retractKe: Hold this combo while aiming at the cube to pick it up. Format: modifiers+key, default shift+right (Shift + right click).
movinglightblock.configuration.lightLeve: Real light emitted, 0 (dark) to 15 (glowstone). Use /reload to update existing blocks.
movinglightblock.configuration.yOffset.t: Height relative to the player's feet: 0 = feet, 1 = head, 2 = above head.
movinglightblock.configuration.followDis: How far you must walk before the first chase. After that it follows whenever you leave the stop radius.
movinglightblock.configuration.stopDista: Stops chasing once this close, so it never sits at your feet.
movinglightblock.configuration.chaseSpee: Speed in blocks per second; 5.6 is about sprint speed. Flies and follows vertically too.
movinglightblock.configuration.teleportD: If the cube ends up farther than this, it is moved back next to you.
